run_translation_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_beam_search_decoding: run beam search decoding on a dataset using a loaded fairseq model ensemble
run_scoring_evaluation: run BLEU scoring evaluation on generated hypotheses against target translations
run_language_model_fusion: run generation with an external language model for rescoring hypotheses
run_alignment_output: run generation with hard or soft alignment output between source and target tokens
